network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto regionale identifica il crollo della rampa di accesso all'attraversamento sul torrente Mazzarra durante l'evento del 3 dicembre 2022, ma non pubblica un livello o una portata alla sezione. La scheda distingue inoltre la rampa collassata dal ponte Termini citato in altre fonti.
network_status.summary_en: The regional report identifies collapse of the access ramp to the Torrente Mazzarra crossing during the 3 December 2022 event but publishes no stage or discharge at the section. The record also distinguishes the collapsed ramp from Ponte Termini cited by other sources.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
